jobs.title: Director of Procurement & Raw Materials Strategy
jobs.description: About Bobbie Bobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.S., because we believe every parent deserves to feed their baby with confidence, without judgment and without compromise. No mystery ingredients. No shortcuts. Just clean, thoughtfully made formula that parents can trust. But Bobbie has never been just a formula company. When the 2022 national infant formula shortage left parents across the country unable to feed their babies, we closed our storefront to new customers rather than leave a single existing family without formula. We went to Washington. We got loud. And we opened our Heath, Ohio manufacturing facility to make sure something like that could never happen again. That's who we are, and that's what you'd be joining. Bobbie for Change Our advocacy arm, Bobbie for Change, exists because making great formula isn't enough if the systems around parenthood are still broken. We fight for paid federal parental leave, push for legislation to prevent future formula shortages, advocate for feeding equity, and support families navigating impossible situations, including donating formula to parents impacted by breast and gynecologic cancers through the Bobbie Breasties program. We're a company that genuinely believes becoming a parent makes you an activist. The people who work here feel that too. About the Role Bobbie is a $150M+ infant nutrition company growing 50% year over year, expanding into new product categories while operating under FDA-regulated infant formula standards. The Director, Procurement & Raw Materials Strategy is a newly created role that will own strategic sourcing and supplier management for the ingredients and packaging behind that growth, reporting directly to the VP, Supply Chain. One person currently handles procurement strategy, supplier negotiation, tactical buying, and cost tracking. Lio is building the AI workforce for procurement : agents that take over the operational work of procurement teams at DAX and Fortune 500 companies around the globe. We’re growing faster than Silicon Valley’s best companies did at our stage, and we’re building the global market leader for AI in procurement . You help make it real at the customer, with more responsibility than you’d ever expect from an internship. What this job really is Right in the middle of it. From day one you’re part of our implementation team and work on operational and strategic topics alike. Your work goes straight into real customer projects. Ownership that grows with you. You work side by side with our Implementation Managers and own parts of real customer implementations from early on. The more you prove yourself, the more you own. In the room where it happens. You help prepare workshops with procurement teams at DAX and Fortune 500 companies, and you’re there when they happen. When the stakes are high, you’re there. Go-lives and critical moments happen in war rooms. You’re part of the team that gets it done, and you’ll learn more in those days than in any lecture hall. Beyond implementation. Trade fairs, events, internal initiatives: wherever Lio needs a hand, you jump in and see how a hypergrowth startup really works. Find your path. You’ll see implementation, product, engineering and sales up close. We’ll help you figure out where you want to go, and then help you get there. What you should know before you apply We’re in the office five days a week. This is not a typical internship and not 9 to 5 . We grow faster than our processes can keep up, and some weeks are intense. In return, you’ll learn more in six months than in years anywhere else. jobs.title: 3D Concept & Visualization Artist (m/f/d) (Freelance / Working Student)
jobs.description: About Dufour Dufour provides sovereign, automated aerial logistics capabilities. Transitioning from a UAV developer into a defence-first network provider, we deliver complete, repeatable operating systems – combining automated aircraft fleets, control rooms, training, and support – to keep critical supplies moving when conventional infrastructure is disrupted. The Role We are looking for a creative and tech-savvy 3D Concept & Visualization Artist to bring our new aircraft designs to life through compelling photorealistic and concept renderings. Working closely with our communications team, you will visualize our upcoming aircraft platforms in real-world mission scenarios – while providing clean base renders that enable our team to generate fast variations using AI tools. What You Will Do Aircraft & Scenario Renderings : Create photorealistic and concept renderings of our new aircraft platforms operating across diverse environments and mission scenarios. 3D Modeling & Scene Setup : Prepare, optimize, and texture existing CAD models, or build complementary concept assets, environments, and lighting setups from scratch. AI-Ready Base Assets & Enablement : Deliver clean, structured base renders and transparent cutouts that enable our internal team to independently generate quick variations and new backgrounds using AI tools. What You Bring 3D & Rendering Tools : Solid experience in 3D modeling and rendering or real-time engines, such as Blender, Cinema 4D, Rhino, Unreal Engine, KeyShot, or Vizcom. AI Workflows & Post-Production : Experience with AI-assisted visualization tools like Vizcom or ComfyUI and image editing – ideally knowing how to structure base renders for downstream AI workflows; basic 3D animation skills are a plus. Eye for Realism & Design : Strong sense of lighting, scale, and industrial or aerospace aesthetics to translate complex hardware into compelling scenes. High Flexibility & Reliability : Pragmatic and responsive – able to jump in on short notice

jobs.description: 🚀 THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Cloud Operations Engineer (Azure) – H/F to join our Cloud Operations team and help us ensure the reliability, security, performance, and cost efficiency of A2MAC1’s Azure cloud environment. In this role, you will take ownership of Azure infrastructure and platform services, drive automation and continuous improvement, and contribute to the design and delivery of secure, reliable, and supportable cloud solutions. You will play a key role in improving operational efficiency, service reliability, and cloud cost optimization. You will work closely with other Cloud Engineers, Product, Engineering, Application Support, and IT teams and report directly to the Cloud Operations Manager. 🌍 ABOUT A2MAC1 A2MAC1 is the leading provider of automotive benchmarking and data analytics worldwide. Our solutions help OEMs and suppliers understand their competitive landscape, accelerate development, and make better strategic decisions based on reliable, structured, and actionable insights. Through our digital platforms, data services, consulting expertise, and AI-driven solutions, A2MAC1 supports the world’s top automotive players. Plan and execute maintenance, upgrades, and migrations through established change management processes. Take ownership of cloud services throughout their lifecycle, lead incident investigations and resolution, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive actions to reduce recurring issues. Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules, Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, and automated operational processes using PowerShell and/or Bash.
